notes.title: Ingression | Trial Level Update
notes.content:
Hey-hey, runners!
We have great news for you all along with a fantastic update! Let's start with the update. We've added a new trial level menu and the latest trial level, “November ‘2024”. From now on, your achievements in the trial levels will be remembered forever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/03a279e3c71a82b4a040b6703147552cf3a78de1.png
And the great news - we’re working to bring Ingression to the Nintendo Switch! It’s a tough path with a lot of challenges to solve before it can happen, so be sure to subscribe to our media and stay tuned for announcements!

Full Patch Notes:
Added

 Added a trial level selection menu where you can play the latest trial and view leaderboards for previous and current trials.
 Added trial level “November ‘24”.

Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the “switch slot” label displayed “clear slot” text.

Thank you for playing! We’d love to see your personal best results on the new trial level page!

Additionally, Ingression is part of Games from Turkey 2024! This is a great opportunity to purchase it at a 30% discount until November 9th, 10 am PT.

notes.title: Ingression | Major Update
notes.content:
Hey runners,
In this update, we've hidden a lot of shiny things in some levels, and you can try to find them NOW!

This update brings new collectibles. By collecting them, you can unlock new levels. Also, you can test your speedrun skills on the new trial level.

Full patch note:
Added

 Added 5 collectible chronothyst gems to chapters 1, 2, 3 & 4; which unlocks a master level for the corresponding chapter after collecting them all in a chapter – You can access them from the Chapter Select Page.
 Added 4 new achievements for completing each master level and 1 for completing all of them.

Fixed

 Fixed an issue with the checkpoint portals’ ambient SFXs in Sector X.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/4aa8b8af4eda9ab8249def4fcedda8a1838d48e4.png

You can now check out the Soundtrack page, where we've gathered all the music from the game, created by the Kargamanes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971740/Ingression_Soundtrack

Thank you for playing! We are eagerly awaiting your personal best results on the leaderboards!

Additionally, the game is part of the Steam Summer Sale, and it's a great opportunity to purchase it at a 30% discount until July 11th, 10 am PDT.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.28, May 19th
notes.content:
v1.0.28
Changed

 Increased the font sizes of the dropdowns in the options menu and the texts of save slot buttons for a better experience on the Steam Deck, and smaller screens.
 Display settings are now saved locally and won’t get cloud-saved, allowing a smoother transition between different devices. Please note that your previous display settings will be lost with this update – sorry!

Fixed

 Fixed some typos in Turkish localization.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.25, May 15th
notes.content:
v1.0.25
Changed

 The credits scene is no longer muted, it plays the main menu theme.
 Removed spikes from some levels of Chapter 3 for more forgiveness.
 Trial Mode spoiler warning will no longer be displayed if you’ve beaten the game on the current save slot.
 Scaled some font sizes of the dialogue UI, the options page, the save slot page, and alert dialogues for a better experience on the Steam Deck, and smaller screens.

Fixed

 Fixed speedrun timer only displaying up to an hour. Now, it can display up to 24 hours and “23:59:59:000+” for anything above.
 Fixed the death counter displaying the Total and Chapter death counts wrong.
 Fixed an unintentional skip on the 5th level of Chapter 2.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.19, May 7th - Chinese Font Fix
notes.content:
v1.0.19
Changed

 Added more lamps to the 22nd level of the First Chapter for more visibility.
 Removed spikes from some levels from Chapter 1 and Prologue for more forgiveness.
 Changed the style of the version displayed in the main menu.

notes.title: Ingression | OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Creating Ingression has been the most thrilling and demanding adventure of my life. For over a year, I've poured my heart and soul into shaping this challenging and mind-bending precision platformer, where each jump is a calculated risk and every portal leads to new trials.

[previewyoutube=_WrC7sOdn4A;full][/previewyoutube]

I spent countless late nights coding, refining, and testing every element of the game. There were moments of frustration when bugs seemed bad and doubts crept in about my ability to see it through alone.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966970/Ingression

For me, Ingression isn't just a game; it's a milestone, a defining moment in my journey as a developer. No matter where life takes me next, I'll always cherish this project, knowing that I created something truly exceptional.

Thank you for purchasing this and sharing your thoughts about it in the reviews!

notes.title: The launch date for Ingression is now set!
notes.content:
Hey-hey runners,

It's been a wild ride. Countless hours of coding, testing, and tweaking every pixel to perfection. But now, it's finally happening. My game, the one I poured my heart and soul into, is coming to life on May 3rd!

[previewyoutube=UgWX8jqDs08;full][/previewyoutube]

To all of you who added it to your wishlist, thank you. Your support means everything. It's been a journey of passion, frustration, and determination, but seeing it all come together is beyond words.

Also, I wanted to share some things I haven't told anyone yet!

Inspiration and Motivation
As a player who loves 2D platformers like Celeste, who is also obsessed with Valve's Portal, I thought of how I could mix these two. I felt like what people call "portals" in 2D games are usually some basic teleportation system, skinned to look like a portal. I wanted to design portals in 2D, such that it would feel seamless like 3D games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/55933662edbf8621b6d7c9aba259b62e815afd58.gif

Development Challenges and Overcoming Them
The biggest development problems that emerged were caused by portals. The biggest issue was how common algorithms and systems used in game development couldn't be used when you have portals that bend spacetime.
In the end, I had to implement portal versions of core systems and common algorithms which made everything interact with portals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/13033af74e4dcba8cff64d462a2b6ffa97513663.gif

Game Features
PORTALS. Ingression has an implementation of portals like no other 2D game ever had before. On top of that, as portals are the main focus of the game, every mechanic and level element interacts with portals to create an immersive and unique experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/29c782de9b04cb4b4aced72a2e2ec1565ea2bad3.gif

So mark your calendars, set your alarms, because on May 3rd, we're diving into a world I've crafted with love and care. Let's make this release one to remember!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966970/Ingression

See you in the year 2442 in the corrupt Galactic Empire.

notes.title: Play Ingression: The Portal Trial for free!
notes.content:
Hey-hey, runners!

We have great news for you all, and it is regarding you being able to play Ingression! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/7c0fd0ac66788b5bdd0395a226bf0b8ca0cea65a.png

We are launching a completely free prologue!
You will be able to complete the first chapter of the game and participate in a special Trial level.

[previewyoutube=xL5ZFyxfM-8;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's the link if you want to install the prologue right now, and while you are downloading and wishlisting it - let's dive into the ✨details✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761970/Ingression_The_Portal_Trial/

Jump through seamless portals

One of the most fun things in the whole game for sure are seamless portals. And when you combine them with a dynamic precision platformer - it creates an absolutely wild gameplay that will put your reflexes to a test!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/29c782de9b04cb4b4aced72a2e2ec1565ea2bad3.gif

We had tons of fun creating these levels, and we hope that you'll have even more fun playing them! I don't want to spoil the fun for you, but in the future, we'll have a LOT more to show to you!

Dynamic gameplay

If you watched the trailer - I think you get what I mean, and if not - [spoiler]please watch it, we worked really hard to put it together 🙏[/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/13033af74e4dcba8cff64d462a2b6ffa97513663.gif

In any case, the levels are designed to be challenging enough for you to struggle your way through them, but not to an "almost impossible" level of struggle. If you are afraid that it will be too hard for you - then hey, give it a shot! The prologue is free and it will be here for a while.

And if you find that the game's levels are too easy...

Challenge yourself with a Trial level!

Oh boy, I've spent countless hours on this one already...

A true testament to your skills and your will to be the best of the best. Sure, just going through it at your own pace is probably not that hard, but try to do it in under 20 seconds and you'll get what I mean. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/55933662edbf8621b6d7c9aba259b62e815afd58.gif

Compete with players worldwide on the leaderboard, or get your friends and decide who's the best once and for all!

And if you'll manage to do it in under 19 seconds... Well, I don't really have a reward for that, but chances are that your name will be on the top of the leadearboard!

Share your experience!

Hop on in our Community Hub to discuss the game, ask questions, and get a response from us! We would LOVE to hear what you think about our game, as we poured our hearts and souls into it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/f9bea3806b9bf2686f307ab5be8579df12d95eb5.gif
